meeting: VPP Insiders session three: the technology stack, integration and measurement
note: The last planned session of the learning group. Four vendors with incompatible positions on standards and open source, and three facts that invert if read carelessly: a platform was acquired rather than built, a standards body's protocol is described as not really a standard, and a regulatory pilot's outcome is explicitly unknown to the speaker who raised it. Attributed by speaker label and company.
